about_the_game:
If you have had a blast so far with Sheep for the Stars, of a deliciously frustrating good time, and you'd like to help me better support this game and future titles... then this Supporter's Pack is a wonderful way to show your support.

While I'm immensely grateful for any and all help, I want to stress that players like you enjoying my games is the most important thing to me. This pack is completely optional, provides only cosmetic changes and has no gameplay impact whatsoever. You won't find any pay-to-win options in here, or locked game mechanics, now or in the future.

I may add more cosmetic goodies to this pack, which would immediately become available to all past / present / future supporters. From the bottom of my heart, regardless of this pack, thank you for checking out and enjoying Sheep for the Stars. I hope to continue to bring you fun and engaging experiences in the future.

Included in the Pack:

  • Precious metal cosmetic sheep pack (bronze, silver, gold, and more)
  • Patterned cosmetic sheep pack (checkers, stripes, and some fun)
  • A new exclusive rocket skin
  • Over 10 new cosmetics (potentially more in the future)

Important Note: This very optional Supporter's Pack absolutely does not (and will not) include any in-game bonus, benefits or gameplay features. It's intended as a cosmetic-only content release, and to help support future Ace High Arcade development. In no way is this pack required to experience the full game content. If anything has a substantial effect on gameplay it is likely a bug / in-error, please report it.
